parsed.title: Daily Check-In Image Generation Hub
parsed.oneLiner: Introduce a daily check-in banner on the Chats Home tab that rewards users with 2 AI Image Credits for playing a quick mini-game, incentivizing daily retention and introducing soft currency monetization.

newMechanic.name: Daily AI Check-In
newMechanic.description: A daily loyalty calendar where users check in to earn free AI Image Credits, which are capped and spent on image creation.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Creates a recurring engagement hook and provides a structured way for free users to experience image generation without abusing the system, while opening up a high-value rewarded ad placement.

parsed.trigger: User taps the Daily Check-In banner on Chats Home to open the check-in modal and initiates the claim.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying, free guests and signed-up users who have not claimed today's check-in reward.

offer.title: Claim Your Daily Credits
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to unlock 2 free AI Image Credits.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The daily check-in limits free credits to just 2 per day, which is enough for only two standard images. High-volume creation and advanced options still require a Luzia+ subscription, preventing any devaluing of the premium tier.

kpis.primary: D7 and D30 user retention rate
kpis.holdout: User-level 10% holdout group kept ineligible for the daily check-in feature for a duration of 28 days.

risks: High image generation API costs if daily active user adoption spikes rapidly, which we mitigate by using a lower-cost compressed image model.
Cannibalization of direct sign-ups, which we control by keeping the daily credit limit strict and showcasing Luzia+ premium styling inside the generation flow.

newScreens.change: Create a Daily Check-In sheet with a weekly progression calendar.

newElements.change: Add a compact 'Daily Check-In Banner' under the welcome text showing today's unclaimed reward.
Add a prominent 'Claim Reward' button that triggers the rewarded video/playable flow.
Add a rewards display showing the earned '2 AI Image Credits' with an animation after completion.

callouts.text: Luzia welcomes the user to the chat.

storyboard.caption: Luzia Chats Home today lacks a daily retention loop or tokens.
We add a daily check-in banner on Chats Home tab.
Tapping the banner displays a weekly check-in calendar to user.
The user plays a 15-second sponsored game with Luzia.
Once completed, the user receives 2 free AI Image Credits.
